findings.title: Dangling workspace report link reaches the native JSON writer
findings.evidence: Actual run_native checks only not report.exists() before Popen. Real dangling-link semantics are exists=false/is_symlink=true, so native launch is admitted. Vitest resolves outputFile then uses promises.writeFile, which follows the leaf link; later guarded copy to E cannot undo an unapproved earlier write. Independent corrected-fake semantics reproduce launch admission, paired with normal absent/existing regular/existing-target link cases. No real path or process was created.

Correct fake exists/is_symlink semantics and add the paired actual-function prelaunch regression. Preserve the now-supported anchored helper/copy/archive and other custody corrections.
